simulation_limits.intrabar_price_order: OHLC M1 bars do not encode tick-level ordering inside a 1-minute bar.
simulation_limits.orderbook_depth_and_real_slippage: No L2 orderbook depth; slippage is modeled via static profile bps.
simulation_limits.exchange_mark_and_liquidation_price: Uses M1 OHLC prices rather than exchange index/mark price or liquidation engine.
simulation_limits.funding_rate: NOT_MODELED unless a historical funding table or rate is explicitly supplied.
simulation_limits.contract_lot_and_tick_rounding: Continuous quantity and price without exchange stepSize/tickSize rounding.
simulation_limits.order_placement_latency: Zero network or matching latency assumed at M1 open.
simulation_limits.exchange_rejected_protective_orders: Assumes TP/SL/trailing protective orders are never rejected by the exchange.
simulation_limits.partial_fills: Assumes 100% fill of leg notional at the modeled fill price.
